front: Scan an area for hidden or undetected creatures, objects, secret doors, or hazards with a secret Perception check.
back:
Area is usually 30 ft or less; GM may penalize distant searching. GM rolls one secret Perception check vs. Stealth DCs or object detection DCs.
Crit Success: hidden/undetected creatures you beat by this much become observed; you learn the location of objects.
Success: undetected become hidden, hidden become observed; you learn an object's location or get a clue.
Creatures may stay hidden if you use an imprecise sense or invisibility prevents observing.
